title: Of All Religions, The Best Religion
summary: Speech is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Of all religions, the best religion
lifeApplication: Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Of all religions, the best religion
